name: separator
description: A visual divider between sections of content. One token, two orientations, no states, no children.

composition.structure: Single flat frame with fill as the separator line.

accessibility.touchTarget: Not required for decorative or structural separator.

constraints: Use only to communicate logical separation.
Spanning dimension should fill the parent.

useCases: Between a page header and its primary content body to signal a transition from navigation context to content
Between groups of form fields that belong to different logical sections (Personal info / Contact details / Preferences)
Between items in a dropdown menu or command palette where grouping aids scanning
Between nav items in a toolbar or horizontal nav strip to divide conceptually separate clusters
Inside a card or panel to divide the header region from the body, or body from the footer
In metadata rows (e.g. 'Author · Date · Read time') to separate inline key-value pairs visually

Horizontal.whenToUse: Dividing stacked content — one section above, another below

Vertical.whenToUse: Dividing side-by-side elements within a single row
examples: Between nav items in a toolbar
Between two columns in a stat row

comparedTo.situation: An explicit visual line between two content regions on the same surface
comparedTo.notInstead: a card border or a raw 1px rectangle

comparedTo.situation: A boundary that defines a card's surface (its own edge)
Grouping related items with implied proximity rather than a hard line
Dividing nav sections in an app-level sidebar

notes: Static component; no state metadata required.

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.
